name: Washio Kyouko
source:
Visual stylist in Kaori's band, Dear.

She prefers not to meddle in others' affairs, and to do things her own way. While not aware of it herself, her appearance & general air of coolness tend to prove useful in winning others over.

She would never, ever admit it out loud, but she is slightly jealous of her bandmate Erika's restless & energetic lifestyle.
